name: Do Anything
description:
Stay on top of every task, habit, and goal — all in one place.
This all-in-one productivity app helps you organize your day, build lasting habits, plan ahead, and track long-term progress — without the clutter.
📅 Today
Add tasks for the day and check them off as you go. When you complete a task, jot down a quick note on what you actually did. Tasks automatically fade and clear out after midnight, keeping your list fresh every morning — and if you didn't finish something, you can recover it back into today's list with one tap.
🔁 Daily
Build habits that matter. Daily tasks reset automatically every day, so you can track routines like exercise, reading, or meditation without recreating them each morning. Mark today's win with a note, and watch your streak continue tomorrow.
🗓️ Planned
Plan ahead with a calendar view. Pick any date, add a task, and get an optional reminder notification — so nothing important slips through the cracks, whether it's tomorrow or three months from now.
🎯 Goal
Break big goals into subjects and track your progress over time. Check off a subject when you make progress, add a remark on what you accomplished, and see a full sorted history of every entry — perfect for tracking learning goals, projects, or personal development.
⏰ Reminders, your way
Every task and habit supports optional alarm/notification reminders — you choose exactly when to be reminded, and only for the tasks that need it.
✅ Built for real life

All your data is saved locally and stays with you — no account, no sign-up required
Full control: edit or delete any task, habit, goal, or entry at any time
Clean, distraction-free design so you can focus on doing, not managing your to-do app

Whether you're organizing today's errands, building a new habit, planning next month, or working toward a big personal goal — this app keeps it all simple, visual, and satisfying to check off.

name: Student Marked
shortDesc: Simple and efficient student attendance management with quick marking, reports, and student manage
description:
## Attendance Management App

A simple, fast, and user-friendly attendance management application designed to make daily student attendance marking easier and more organized.

### Key Features

* **Quick Attendance Marking** – Mark students as Present, Absent, or POD with a simple tap.
* **Student Management** – Add, edit, and manage students from the master student list.
* **Lecture-wise Attendance** – Maintain attendance separately for different lectures.
* **TG Attendance** – Dedicated support for TG (Teacher Guardian) attendance.
* **Date-wise Records** – Select a date and manage attendance for that specific day.
* **Attendance Summary** – View Present, POD, Absent, and Total student counts instantly.
* **Attendance Reports** – Generate a clear attendance report after completing attendance.
* **Copy & Share** – Copy Present/POD or Absent student data and directly open the system share option.
* **Delete Students** – Select and remove students when required.
* **Local Data Storage** – Attendance and student information can be maintained within the application for convenient access.

### Easy to Use

The application is designed with a clean interface and a simple workflow so attendance can be completed quickly without unnecessary steps. Student information and attendance records are organized to make everyday classroom attendance management convenient.

**Built for students, class representatives, teachers, and academic attendance management.**
